review_summary: H01-029 DONE/PASS under Founder-approved five-UDD scope. Live acceptance proved five concurrent Brave profiles from five distinct UDDs: p001/s01, p006/s02, p011/s03, p016/s04, p021/s05. CDP PASS on 9201,9206,9211,9216,9221; p001 browsed Gemini and the other four loaded Example Domain. Concurrent telemetry: 64 Brave processes, 22 renderers, about 7490.5 MiB RSS. Storage gate reported live_count=5 and hard_cap=5, so no sixth profile was admitted. Founder scope explicitly excludes authentication, provider generation/output extraction, and 8/10-owner scale. H01-108 p001 was not restarted or closed; bounded canaries required no credential/session-secret access.
